DIAGNOSIS READY: Erythema Infecciosum (Fifth Disease).

The classic "slapped cheek" appearance combined with the lacy, reticular rash on the trunk and extremities, along with your recent viral prodrome of fever and headache, is highly characteristic of Parvovirus B19 infection. The presence of joint pain or sensitivity to light would further support this diagnosis, though the rash pattern alone is often sufficient for clinical confirmation.
